warnings: Zero violations on an empty or valid fixture does not mean the database prevents invalid writes.
Negative inserts, concurrent races, migration replay, permission denial and real catalog comparison remain untested.
Run only on a disposable PostgreSQL database seeded with synthetic non-sensitive records.
Join predicates and source columns verified against committed Drizzle 0036, NOT live schema.

raceProbes are source-audit requirements, not executed results. SOURCE_PROTECTED_NEEDS_EXECUTION does not mean PASS; SOURCE_CONFIRMED_GAP requires implementation before DB phase certification; DRAFT_UNIMPLEMENTED has no registered runtime contract.
Race source protection is not acceptance: every P5-R* scenario remains NOT_RUN until the disposable PostgreSQL gate is available.

raceProbes.purpose: Application must not commit after paid-module or inherited placement eligibility is revoked between precheck and insert
raceProbes.currentProtection: DB-054 locks the live job, learner membership/academic chain and existing access/eligibility inputs in the application transaction, re-evaluates eligibility after ordering locks, persists only the live result, and aligns policy/override/evidence writers on job/membership locks. Runtime race proof is still NOT_RUN.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Run the deterministic DB18 P5-R01 witness: a paid-module writer acquires the rule/membership ordering locks first, disables placements, then releases the application. The application must reject and persist zero placement_applications.

raceProbes.purpose: Learner enrollment must not commit into a cohort that becomes non-mutable after the precheck
raceProbes.currentProtection: Enrollment transaction re-reads the cohort with FOR SHARE, revalidates PLANNED/ACTIVE and program identity, and holds that parent row against concurrent lifecycle transition until enrollment + activity commit.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: T1 loads an ACTIVE cohort and pauses; T2 completes/archives it; T1 resumes. Enrollment insert must not commit after the cohort is no longer mutable.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent last-seat joins to one group serialize
raceProbes.currentProtection: joinGroup locks the elective slot first when present, then SELECT ... FOR UPDATE on the group before active_count/capacity and waitlist decisions.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: With one seat left, run two joins concurrently; prove active_count never exceeds capacity and exactly one contender receives the seat.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent elective joins across different offering groups still respect slot max_pick
raceProbes.currentProtection: All offering groups in one elective slot serialize on the shared elective_slots row before counting ACTIVE/WAITLISTED picks.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: For max_pick=1, concurrently join two distinct offering groups from the same slot for one learner; at most one pick may commit.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent final quiz attempts cannot exceed max_attempts
raceProbes.currentProtection: Transaction takes a shared quiz lock, rechecks persisted membership/role and acquires pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed by quiz+membership before counting attempts and inserting.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: With exactly one attempt remaining, submit two concurrent attempts for the same learner/quiz; one commits and the other returns max-attempts/state failure with no orphan answers.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent task submissions produce one accepted transition into IN_REVIEW
raceProbes.currentProtection: Version is read before the transaction, but the transaction conditionally updates the task only when it is neither DONE nor IN_REVIEW; the losing writer must roll back before its submission insert.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Submit the same task concurrently; exactly one transaction updates the task and inserts the next version; the loser produces no submission/activity row.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent cohort lifecycle transitions have one winner for the same expected status
raceProbes.currentProtection: UPDATE cohorts is compare-and-set with WHERE id=? AND status=expectedStatus; zero-row update becomes INVALID_COHORT_TRANSITION.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Run two ACTIVATE (or COMPLETE) transitions concurrently from the same starting state and prove exactly one row update succeeds.

raceProbes.purpose: Scheduled-job lease takeover fences a stale worker
raceProbes.currentProtection: The PostgreSQL lease store uses DB clock authority, atomic INSERT..ON CONFLICT takeover, monotonically increasing fence, and holder+fence+unexpired predicates for renew/current checks. The schema remains a draft outside the active migration journal.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: After the draft is registered on disposable PostgreSQL: worker A acquires fence n and stalls past expiry; worker B acquires n+1; A renew/current/finalization using n must fail while B retains ownership.

raceProbes.purpose: Outbound dispatcher retry/claim races do not create duplicate logical sends or allow stale claim updates
raceProbes.currentProtection: Queue insertion is atomic/idempotent by unique idempotency_key, validates request_digest on duplicate, and refuses an active suppression at enqueue time. The schema remains a draft and no verified dispatcher/claimer state machine currently closes claim/provider/retry races.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: After registration and dispatcher implementation: race two enqueue calls and two claimers for one logical message; prove one logical message, one current claim owner, monotonic fence, stable request digest, and no duplicate provider send after crash/retry.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent occurrences of one log signature increment durable triage memory atomically
raceProbes.currentProtection: Draft has unique (environment,signature_hash), occurrence_count and triage fields but no runtime upsert producer.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Insert the same new signature concurrently from multiple workers; prove one signature row, exact occurrence_count increment, monotonic first/last seen and no lost FIXED→regressed transition.

raceProbes.purpose: Schedule creation/update must not commit after its academic period is concurrently CLOSED
raceProbes.currentProtection: Create/update preflight still loads period status, but both write transactions now SELECT the scoped academic_periods row FOR SHARE and recheck its status/date bounds before writing. Concurrent CLOSED transitions serialize against that parent lock; runtime confirmation remains NOT_RUN.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: T1 validates an ACTIVE period and pauses; T2 CLOSES the period and commits; T1 resumes create/update. T1 must fail or serialize behind the period transition rather than commit a SCHEDULED event into a CLOSED period.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent COMPLETE versus WITHDRAW on one learner program enrollment leaves parent and active section enrollments in one coherent terminal state
raceProbes.currentProtection: The transaction first updates active child section enrollments and then CAS-updates the parent only from ACTIVE. A losing parent CAS throws, rolling back its child updates with the transaction.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Race COMPLETE and WITHDRAW from ACTIVE; exactly one parent transition commits and every formerly-active section enrollment has the same terminal status as the winning parent, with no mixed child state.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent assignment submissions cannot double-submit a learner or consume one upload receipt twice
raceProbes.currentProtection: Submission holds a shared assignment lock, rechecks persisted learner identity/role, locks FILE upload receipts FOR UPDATE, conditionally consumes an unrevoked/unconsumed receipt, and relies on assignment_submissions_assignment_membership_uq for one learner submission.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Race two submissions for one learner/assignment, including two uses of the same FILE receipt. Exactly one submission/receipt consumption commits, no orphan file row remains, and the loser maps to the expected conflict.

raceProbes.purpose: Two concurrent sprint starts/reopens cannot create more than one ACTIVE sprint for a project
raceProbes.currentProtection: Lifecycle mutations lock the project then target sprint, inspect active sibling rows under lock, use state CAS, and have project_sprints_active_project_uq as a final invariant.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Race starts of two PLANNED sprints (and separately a reopen against a start); prove at most one ACTIVE sprint and coherent project/release state.

raceProbes.purpose: Application submission cannot win against a concurrent job close/archive, role deactivation, or drive-day coordinator assignment
raceProbes.currentProtection: The application transaction locks/rechecks the job and selected role; the coordinator writer is documented to take the same job-row lock; insert uses conflict-safe application uniqueness.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Pause application after precheck and concurrently close/archive job, deactivate role, or assign the learner as coordinator. Whichever conflicting mutation orders first must make the incompatible application fail, with no screening/history/event residue.

raceProbes.purpose: Eligibility bulk decide, later decide, and undo serialize without stale undo or split current/event history
raceProbes.currentProtection: Every eligibility writer/undo takes the college row FOR UPDATE. Undo verifies latest event/current state for every touched scope before modifying any row, then writes current state plus append-only reversal events in one transaction.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Race DECIDE/DECIDE and DECIDE/UNDO over overlapping scopes; prove serialized current decisions, append-only ordered events, and stale undo rejection without partial reversal.

raceProbes.purpose: Offer issuance and response races cannot create duplicate active offers or contradictory ACCEPTED/DECLINED histories
raceProbes.currentProtection: Offer issuance runs SERIALIZABLE, locks application/screening and rechecks round readiness; response locks the offer FOR UPDATE and CAS-transitions from ISSUED. Joining outcome creation is conflict-safe.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Race two offer issuers, then separately ACCEPT versus DECLINE on one ISSUED offer. Prove one active version/one terminal response and exactly matching history/activity rows.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent announcement edit/delete/restore cannot silently overwrite a newer version
raceProbes.currentProtection: Mutations require expectedVersion and update with id+version plus deleted-state predicates; zero-row update becomes STALE_VERSION. Schema is still a draft, so runtime protection is not registered.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: After migration registration, race edit/edit, edit/delete and restore/delete from one version; exactly one version increment wins and the loser returns STALE_VERSION.

raceProbes.purpose: Bug-tracker workflow updates cannot lose a concurrent change or commit state without its immutable activity
raceProbes.currentProtection: Admin workflow update runs in one transaction, computes a state-machine transition, CAS-updates by loaded version, then appends activity; stale version aborts the transaction. Schema is not registered.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: After migration registration, race two workflow transitions from the same version; one wins, one is STALE_VERSION, and only the committed transition has a matching activity row.

raceProbes.purpose: Duplicate in-app delivery and concurrent read acknowledgement remain idempotent
raceProbes.currentProtection: Delivery uses unique(user_id,event_id)+ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; read uses read_at IS NULL conditional update and refetches the committed row if another reader wins.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Race duplicate delivery for one user/event and race two mark-read calls; prove one notification row, accurate duplicate accounting, and one durable read timestamp with both callers observing committed state.

raceProbes.purpose: A suppression created after enqueue but before provider dispatch must prevent the send
raceProbes.currentProtection: The queue explicitly documents that enqueue-time suppression is insufficient because unsubscribe/bounce can race after insertion; every sender MUST re-check durable suppression before dispatch. No verified sender currently exists.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: After dispatcher implementation, enqueue unsuppressed message, insert suppression before claim/send, then run dispatcher. Provider must not be called and the row must end in a non-send suppressed state.

raceProbes.purpose: Concurrent edits to one scheduled event need an explicit lost-update policy
raceProbes.currentProtection: updateSectionScheduleEvent CAS-checks only status=SCHEDULED. Two editors can both read the same event and sequentially overwrite overlapping fields with no version/expectedUpdatedAt token.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: Define whether last-write-wins is intentional. If not, add optimistic versioning and race two edits from the same version so one fails stale; if yes, record the policy and test field-level merge/overwrite expectations.

raceProbes.purpose: Leave/waitlist promotion racing a new join cannot overfill the group or promote two learners into one seat
raceProbes.currentProtection: Join and leave/promotion paths serialize through the same group FOR UPDATE lock (and elective slot first when applicable) before capacity/waitlist state changes and event writes.
raceProbes.requiredWitness: With a full group and waitlist, race an ACTIVE leave against a new join; prove capacity is never exceeded, at most one learner consumes the released seat, waitlist positions remain coherent and events match committed states.

raceAudit.note: Source protection is not a PASS. P5-R01 and P5-R02 now have authored locking/revalidation fixes but both remain runtime-pending; every scenario still requires disposable-PostgreSQL execution before DATABASE certification.
